mapper.insert: INSERT INTO travel_log (user_id, province, city, location_name, lng, lat, content, img_list, travel_date) VALUES (#{userId}, #{province}, #{city}, #{locationName}, #{lng}, #{lat}, #{content}, #{imgList}, #{travelDate})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, province, city, location_name, lng, lat, content, img_list, travel_date, created_at FROM travel_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM travel_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND province = #{province}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM travel_log WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT province FROM travel_log WHERE user_id = #{userId}
